name: Bearish Engulfing
description: A two-candle bearish reversal pattern. The first candle is bullish and the second candle is a larger bearish candle whose real body completely engulfs the real body of the first candle. Signals a decisive shift from buying to selling pressure.

body_rules.candle_1: bullish (green/white) real body of any size
body_rules.candle_2: bearish (red/black) real body that opens at or above candle 1 close and closes at or below candle 1 open
body_rules.engulfment: candle 2 body must fully contain candle 1 body; the larger candle 2 body is relative to candle 1, the stronger the signal

wick_rules.candle_1_wicks: not relevant to the pattern definition
wick_rules.candle_2_wicks: ideally small; large lower wicks on candle 2 reduce conviction
wick_rules.engulfment_wicks: body-to-body engulfment is the primary rule; wick-to-wick engulfment is an even stronger version

context_requirement: must appear at the end of an uptrend or at a key resistance level; engulfing patterns in ranging markets or mid-trend are less reliable
volume_requirement: candle 2 volume should be significantly higher than candle 1 volume; this confirms the surge in selling pressure
agent_rules: Confirm the pattern is at a resistance zone, trendline, or significant Fibonacci level
Enter short at the open of candle 3 or after candle 2 closes
Stop loss above the high of candle 2 (or the pattern high)
The larger candle 2 is relative to candle 1, the stronger the reversal signal
High volume on candle 2 is a critical confirmation factor
A bearish engulfing that also engulfs the wicks of candle 1 is considered stronger
Avoid trading this pattern after a very small candle 1 (a tiny bullish candle is easily engulfed and may not signal enough prior buying)
